title: Rethinking Training for De-biasing Text-to-Image Generation: Unlocking the Potential of Stable Diffusion
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure faith or religion; it focused on gender and racial bias in text-to-image generation models, specifically concerning the representation of various professions.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study.
